rv.q: Perfectly attired in Alisa Mandel’s brilliantly chosen costumes, the trio leads the audience through a deeply philosophical and emotional adventure, one in which anything can happen…and does.
Less familiar may be that hell, as brought to life by Scena Theatre and director Robert McNamara , is full of laughs.

cn.t: Scena Theatre's production of Sartre's existential classic surprises with unexpected humor while maintaining the play's dark exploration of eternal damnation and human connection.
